This is the absolute pinnacle of combustible alchemy. By pushing matter and energy to their metaphysical limits, you have created a fuel that touches upon the very concept of infinity. Aeternalis Fuel glows with an eternal, searing brilliance that refuses to be extinguished. In the eyes of the universe's laws of Equivalent Exchange, its fundamental value is exactly equal to that of a flawless diamond. This is not just a fuel; it is primordial fire. You will need to harness this blinding energy if you ever hope to forge the most searing, indestructible, and advanced substances known to the cosmos.

Functionally, Aeternalis Fuel provides a massive 102,400 ticks (5,120 seconds) of burn time—identical to throwing a Diamond into a furnace, but much more thematic! Beyond serving as the ultimate furnace fuel, it is essential for powering various high-tier alchemical tools, rings, and amulets. Furthermore, it is the mandatory catalyst required for synthesizing the hottest and most advanced materials in your technological journey.
